summary: India is preparing for the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi set for crucial bilateral meetings with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping.Modi is scheduled to meet Putin on September 11, followed by talks with Xi Jinping on September 12. Xi's India visit is particularly significant as it will be his first trip to India since the 2020 Galwan clash. The two leaders are expected to discuss the broader India-China relationship, the border situation and economic ties.The Modi-Putin talks are also expected to focus on energy, defence and the wider India-Russia strategic partnership. India is seeking concrete economic outcomes from its BRICS chairmanship, including stronger trade and investment, resilient supply chains, technology cooperation, energy security and greater cooperation in global governance.But the summit comes amid major geopolitical challenges, including the West Asia conflict, the Ukraine war and growing US-China tensions. summary: PM Narendra Modi has shared a new Instagram reel ahead of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, highlighting India’s leadership of the grouping as the country prepares to host some of the world’s most powerful leaders.India is currently holding the BRICS chairmanship for 2026, with the summit scheduled for September 12–13 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The Indian presidency is built around the themes of resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability.The reel comes at a crucial geopolitical moment. Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to visit India for the first time in seven years, while Russian President Vladimir Putin is also due in New Delhi. Modi is expected to hold key bilateral discussions with both leaders on the sidelines of the summit.BRICS is also facing major challenges. The ongoing Iran conflict has exposed divisions within the expanded grouping, particularly between Iran and the UAE. India will have to work to build consensus while presenting BRICS as a stronger voice for the Global South. n18oc_indiaNews18 Mobile App - https://onelink.to/desc-youtube
